title: Correct emf expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the instantaneous induced emf as e = 500 sin(100πt) V or equivalent with correct amplitude and angular frequency.

title: Correct Joule heat
description: Essential: The response must give the Joule heat per rotation as 500 J (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Maximum emf calculation
description: Important: The student should correctly compute the maximum emf using E_m = NBSω, obtaining 500 V.

title: Effective value derivation
description: Important: The student must convert the maximum emf to its effective value using E = E_m/√2 for sinusoidal AC.

title: Circuit resistance inclusion
description: Important: The Joule heat calculation must use the total resistance (R + r = 5 Ω) in the power formula.

title: Period for one rotation
description: Important: The student should correctly determine the time for one full rotation as T = 2π/ω = 0.02 s.

title: Sine vs cosine error
description: Pitfall: Using cosine instead of sine for the instantaneous emf when timing starts from the neutral plane.

title: Peak vs RMS confusion
description: Pitfall: Using the peak emf (500 V) instead of the effective value when calculating Joule heat.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Failing to include proper units (V, J) or using incorrect units in final answers.
